comparator.description: Identical contextual facts in both arms; direct complete English for the question asked. Scope and omitted dimensions are explicit in DESIGN.md.

attempt.estimand: Difference in comprehension accuracy (percentage points) between the marked forms prob(E)=p / odds-for(E)=a:b / odds-against(E)=b:a and the complete careful-English statement of the same reported probability claim, on the source's three held-out probes (event probability share, complement share, equivalent odds-against orientation), over 72 wholly fresh items = the source's nine equal-weight settlement strata x 8, never pooled across strata for settlement; a fresh-input settlement replication of Dexagon's original 342303a33f… on a different two-lineage local reader class.
admissibility_gates: each reader alone clears the planted calibration control (absolute-gap-v1, min_gap 0.5) without retry selection
every real item is fresh for this principal: new events, model labels and numeric values; zero pair or arm overlap with the source kit
the nine settlement strata are the source's, equal weight, every one load-bearing; no pooled figure stands in for any
no reader cell is retried; a transport fault or bound truncation is a typed dead cell, and the yield guard decides whether the run may emit
